scenicChapters.title: Great St Bernard Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 16 km this is Great St Bernard Pass Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand St Bernard
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2469 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

great-st-bernard-pass-road.story: Out of Martigny-Ville, one way: 75 km, roughly 1 h 14 in the saddle. The stops in between: Orsieres and Great St Bernard Pass. The highest point is about 2,450 m. Great St Bernard Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It crosses from Switzerland into Italy - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
